task.name: Dense triangle-free graphs on 16 vertices with chromatic number at least four
task.family: science prize f four chromatic triangle free
task.description: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of a simple triangle-free graph on vertices 0..15 that is not 3-colourable (exact backtracking). Maximize the number of edges. A valid graph with m edges shows f_4(16) > m; the published formula applies only to n >= 150.
